# Mistravora

> Mistravora is a Sri Lankan software company that builds high-performance websites, web platforms, e-commerce stores, business software, and AI-powered features for clients in Sri Lanka and worldwide. Founded and headquartered in Kurunegala, Sri Lanka. Serving clients globally including Dubai, UAE.

## Identity

- Legal name: Mistravora

- Coordinates: 7.421684, 80.466742
- Business hours: Mon-Fri 9:00-18:00 (Asia/Colombo)
- Type: Software development company
- Specialization: Web platforms, business software, e-commerce, AI integration

## What Mistravora Does

Mistravora designs, builds, and maintains custom software products including:

- **Custom Web Platforms** — High-performance marketing sites, portals, and web apps built on Next.js with strict performance budgets.
- **Business Software** — Internal tools, dashboards, and workflow systems that replace spreadsheets and manual processes.
- **E-Commerce** — Fast storefronts and ordering systems optimized for Sri Lankan and international customers.
- **Mobile-Ready Products** — Progressive web apps that install like native apps and keep working on slow networks.
- **AI-Powered Features** — Chat assistants, smart search, and automation grounded in your own business data.
- **Care & Maintenance** — Ongoing support, monitoring, and iteration so your platform keeps improving after launch.

## Pricing

- **Starter** (LKR 150k+) — 5-8 page marketing website, CMS, SEO, analytics, contact forms, 30 days support
- **Growth** (LKR 400k+) — Everything in Starter plus calculators, blog, case studies, booking, automation, 90 days support
- **Custom** (scoped quote) — Everything in Growth plus client portals, dashboards, AI features, dedicated delivery, ongoing partnership

## Case Studies (Proven Results)

- [ShopMate — E-commerce Platform](/projects/shopmate-ecommerce-platform) — 65% increase in online orders, real-time inventory sync, POS integration
- [Unic Motors — Service Management](/projects/unic-motors-service-management) — 50% reduction in missed appointments, automated SMS reminders
- [Dubai Store — Online Store](/projects/dubai-store-online-store) — 30% of revenue from online, AI-powered search, multi-currency
- [Assalafiya Book Shop — Bookstore Management](/projects/assalafiya-book-shop-management) — 80% reduction in inventory errors, barcode scanning
- [TamDrill — Drilling Services Management](/projects/tamdrill-drilling-services-management) — 45% reduction in equipment downtime, conflict-free scheduling
- [Amaluna Resorts — Booking System](/projects/amaluna-resorts-booking-system) — 70% increase in direct bookings, double bookings eliminated
- [Wijesinghe Jewellers — Inventory & POS](/projects/wijesinghe-jewellers-inventory-pos) — 99% inventory accuracy, live gold rate tracking

## Tech Stack

- Frontend: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Three.js
- Backend: Node.js, Supabase, PostgreSQL
- AI: Anthropic Claude, OpenAI
- Infrastructure: Cloudflare R2, Vercel, AWS S3
- Monitoring: Sentry, PostHog
- Payments: Stripe
- Email: Resend

## Key Differentiators

- Performance-first engineering — sub-second load times, Core Web Vitals in green
- Privacy-first defaults — GDPR-aware, data ownership
- AI-powered — AI assistants and automation baked in where they create real leverage
- Mobile-ready — touch-first layouts tested across devices
- SEO-optimized — semantic markup, structured data, clean URLs
- Sri Lanka-based, globally serving — clients in Sri Lanka, UAE, and beyond
